# Awtarchy v4.1.2 Qalc and Default Applications

Two focused desktop updates: a live Qalc calculator replaces SpeedCrunch, and a simple menu makes changing Awtarchy's default applications easier.

## Install and update

- [Installation guide](https://github.com/dillacorn/awtarchy/blob/main/INSTALL.md)
- [Updating guide](https://github.com/dillacorn/awtarchy/blob/main/UPDATING.md)
- Existing installations: `awtarchy update`.

## Qalc calculator

- Live results appear while typing, with input fixed near the bottom and completed calculations stacking upward.
- Opens in a themed floating Foot window through the existing calculator shortcuts. Search for **Qalc Calculator** in the application launcher.
- Old SpeedCrunch user settings are preserved.

## Default Applications

- Press **Super+Alt+A**, search for **Default Applications**, or choose **apps** in Quickshell Quick Settings.
- Choose an installed terminal, browser, file manager, or text editor; the selection applies immediately without a separate Save step.
- Arrow keys, Space, Enter, mouse controls, and search use Awtarchy Tips-style navigation.
- Calculator selection and existing MIME/file associations remain unchanged.

## Validation

- Dedicated Qalc and Default Applications regression suites passed, including keyboard/mouse navigation and preference persistence.
- The Default Applications PR (#314) passed 29 of 30 GitHub checks; the remaining failure was an unrelated USB security test ShellCheck SC2329 warning.
- Both interfaces were exercised on an Arch desktop during branch testing; other hardware and application combinations have not been exhaustively tested.
